text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Craft. Spe-san and I are
going out today. We'll be having dinner out, too."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, have a safe trip!
Today is my crafting day!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I see. What are you going to make next?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
A keychain!
If it turns out well... hehe, I want to give it to a precious friend.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Craft's handmade crafts are always so good.
I'm sure it'll turn out great this time, too."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'll do my best. So that they'll be happy!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: It's basically a keychain, but I added a rotating pin so it can also be worn as a brooch...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
The pins and accessory parts absolutely must be gold.
To give it an elegant, refined feel...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I'm home...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, I knew it. She's still making it.
As always, her focus is incredible."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~ I definitely want to use these white flowers.
But these iridescent sequins are nice too~...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Her casual outfit has a chic feel to it,
so I think it'll make a nice accent piece.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Carefully slide it over, put both on top...
Yeah, that looks pretty good...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Craft? Craft!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Cesario?
When did you get back?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Just a moment ago. More importantly...
didn't you forget to eat your meal?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Aah! It's already this late!?
Dinner time is already over...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I figured as much.
Here, take this.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Um, is this... for me?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I sent a message while I was out,
but there hasn't been any reply..."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I figured you were probably super focused
and forgot to eat, just like always.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Spe-san went with me to buy these on the way back.
Please, have some if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Cesario... and Spe-san too~.
Thank you... you really saved me.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's good to hear.
Just make sure not to overdo it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll be careful.
I just get so absorbed in it... because it's so fun.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: My current feelings and devotion taking shape and lasting forever. When I think about that—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I just want to pour everything I am right now
into every single piece of work!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...When you look like you're having that much fun,
there's no way I could stop you."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sorry for always burdening you.
Thank you, Cesario."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, for a cute keychain,
we need cute, fluffy wrapping...
choice_data_list: Is it a present for someone?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes! For Cesario! I made
a handmade keychain for her!
choice_data_list: It's a really well-thought-out design, isn't it?
Don't push yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Can you tell?
As expected of you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Cesario doesn't wear accessories very often... so as a little experiment, I made it so it can also be used as a brooch.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: These are the flowers we said were "cute" before... I wonder if she'll notice.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "I made it with so much care, thinking about Cesario the whole time."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... I hope they like it♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you see right through me, Trainer...
I just get totally absorbed in it.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I'd end up going to sleep late or forgetting to eat meals. Actually, the same thing happened when I was making this keychain...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
“Even so, Cesario always looks out for me
and helps me through it.”

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
That's why... to say thank you for everything.
I made this packed with all my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I hope my feelings
reach you, even just a little...!"
